report.model_summary: Paid November revenue rose from $189,316.83 to $320,221.55 (+$130,904.72, +69%). Most is real: correctly-measured paid revenue grew to $304,396.67 (+$115,079.84), including $106,760.98 from 1,077 paid orders on Nov 25-30 (Black Friday/Cyber Monday) plus backfill growth in Nov 1-24. The remainder (+$15,824.88 from 146 orders) is a defect from including status='pending'. Corrected November paid revenue is $304,396.67.
